nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What assumption is made about knowledge sharing among countries in the agreement?
nodes.answer: The assumption is that members of the agreement fully share their knowledge about adaptation capacity, and some knowledge unintentionally spills over between signatory and non-signatory countries, as well as between two non-signatory countries.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Bilateral climate agreements_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: How do members of the agreement share their knowledge regarding adaptation capacity?
nodes.answer: Members of the agreement fully share their knowledge about adaptation capacity, and there is an assumption of unintentional knowledge spillover between signatory and non-signatory countries.

nodes.question: What strategic alliance is being strengthened according to the gas agreements mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: A strategic alliance between Russia and China is being strengthened due to the gas agreements.
